parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query this ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values:

- 30 (default)

- 50

- 100

parameters.name: TargetMajorVersion
parameters.description: The major engine version to which you want to upgrade the instance. This version must be later than the current major engine version of the instance.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the pre-upgrade check task. The UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck operation returns this ID in the **TaskId** parameter.
